violation_type.title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures parents access minimum standards online, TX A/N hotline, and HHSC website (26 TAC §744.501(20))
violation_type.short_title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures parents access minimum standards online, TX A/N hotline, and HHSC website
violation_type.typical_finding: Operational Policies were missing procedures for how parents can access minimum standards online and HHSC website.

finding_variants.text: Operational Policies were missing procedures for how parents can access minimum standards online and HHSC website.
Instructions on how parens can access the Minimum standards online, Texas Abuse and Neglect Hotline; and HHSC website need to be added to the operation's policies.
Operational policies are missing statement on how to access HHSC information regarding website, and Abuse and Neglect hot line.
Operational policies were not available for review.
